text.content:
template: raes-library-template
version: 1
id: minimal-validated-scenario
surface: scenario
requirement_refs:
- AUT-806
source_refs:
- docs/explain/sdl/sections.md
- docs/explain/sdl/validation.md
summary: Minimal current-SDL scenario with a target, participant, objective, and workflow.
validation:
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen python tools/check_example_library.py
  expected: Exits 0 with no output. The gate reads this file with the sdl-yaml/v1
    loader, which rejects duplicate keys and merge keys. It parses the body with the
    SDL parser and semantic validator and fails on any error or advisory.
- command: uv run --project implementations/python --frozen raes semantic validate
    my-scenario.sdl.yaml
  expected: 'With the body saved as my-scenario.sdl.yaml, prints "validate: success"
    and exits 0. This command does not report semantic-validator advisories.'
body:
  name: library-scenario-template
  description: Minimal scenario template exercising identity, target, objective, and
    workflow refs.
  nodes:
    app:
      type: compute
      architecture: x86_64
      resources:
        ram: 1 GiB
        cpu: 1
      services:
      - port: 443
        name: https
  conditions:
    app-healthy:
      proposition: app-healthy
      command: curl -fsS https://app/health
      interval: 30
  entities:
    blue-team:
      role: blue
  agents:
    operator:
      affiliations:
      - blue-team
  propositions:
    app-healthy:
      description: The governed app-healthy observation is true for the addressed
        scenario subject.
      subjects:
      - nodes.app.services.https
      basis: observed_state
      predicate:
        kind: boolean
        property: app-healthy
        semantic_ref: urn:raes:observable:app-healthy
        operator: equals
        expected: true
      evidence_requirements:
      - objective-truth-evidence
  assertions:
    app-healthy:
      proposition: app-healthy
      role: postcondition
      polarity: positive
  evidence_requirements:
    objective-truth-evidence:
      description: Capture evidence used to decide authored proposition assertions.
      source_refs:
      - nodes.app.services.https
      scope: authored assertion evaluation
      boundary_kind: assertion_evaluation
      channel: log
      artifact_role: proposition_truth_evidence
      media_types:
      - application/json
      sensitivity: plain
      redaction: redact_secrets
      integrity: checksum
      retention: study_lifetime
      loss_disclosure: required
  objectives:
    verify-app-health:
      assigned_participant: operator
      targets:
      - nodes.app.services.https
      success:
        assertions:
        - app-healthy
  workflows:
    baseline-check:
      start: verify
      steps:
        verify:
          type: objective
          objective: verify-app-health
          on_success: done
        done:
          type: end
name: changed
